title: ARG Telemetry Lineage Block
description: Deterministic hash of prompt version, model weights, temperature, and parent message GUIDs for multi-turn forensics

prompt_version_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the system prompt in effect at this turn

model_weights_hash.description: Hash of model weights where available

temperature.description: Temperature setting at time of inference

turn_number.description: Sequential turn number within the session

parent_message_guid.description: GUID of the parent message in the conversation chain
